exact_source_delta.typed_size: st_mode exact int and regular file; st_size exact int (bool rejected), nonnegative and <=16MiB.
exact_source_delta.actual_read: with fixed.open(rb): handle.read(16MiB+1); reject excess before hashing. Never read_bytes/read(-1) at this boundary.
exact_source_delta.preserved_finally: Global all-client closure unchanged, always attempted before verdict/native; original component STOP unchanged when reference failure follows.

new_actual_regressions: Exactly one read request of16MiB+1, no unbounded -1 read
post-stat growth returns cap+1 sentinel, rejects OVERSIZED before hash/native
typed invalid sizes negative/bool/string/None reject before read; oversized stat rejects before read
stat/open errors retain fixed path+UNAVAILABLE+correct present-known/unknown marker
absent report after child throw retains ABSENT/path and original STOP
normal/partial/malformed/throw/unknownfields/wrongCID/global-otherclient failures preserve existing closure and qualification limits
